entities.text: G. Raghuram Sharma, Medak vs State Of A.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Criminal Petition is filed under Sec.482 Cr.P.C., by the Petitioner/Accused No.4 seeking quash of C.C.No.136/2005 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Allagadda, Kurnool District for the offences said to have committed under Section 7 (i) & 2 (a) (m) which is punishable under Sec.16 (1) (a) (i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Allagadda, Kurnool District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: At the time of hearing, Sri Sk.Mohammad Ismail, learned counsel representing Sri N.Niranjan Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that C.C.No.136/2005 on the file of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Allagadda, Kurnool District was disposed of on 14.09.2018 and the Petitioner / Accused No.4 was discharged.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Allagadda, Kurnool District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In view of the said submission, this Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
